Subject: Re: [opensuse] network printer problem

Joe Morris pecked at the keyboard and wrote:
> On 02/26/2008 07:31 PM, jdd wrote:
>> Time ago this problem didn't exist, any pending printing to a stopped
>> printer was automatically resent when switching on the printer.
> And can be again.
>>
>> It's no more the case. Is this a bug or a feature??
> An option.
>> What I did:
>> go to yast, add me to the group "lp"
> not necessary.
>>
>> lauch firefox and go to
>>  http://localhost:631
>> then, in "printers" page, my printer is noted "stopped", but here is a
>> button "start the printer".
>>
>> I clic on the button and I'm asked for a login and a passwd. I give
>> ''my'' login and ''my'' passwd (linux one, not cups one) and voilà,
>> the printer is started and prints.
> You could login as root, and go to the Printers tab, then Set Printer
> Options, at the bottom, change Error policy to retry-job, then Set
> Printer Options.  This will make it retry the job when you reset the
> printer instead of stopping it.  HTH.
> 

Or simply from the command line as root:

cupsenable
